title: Noetherian schemes have small perfect representatives
statement: For a Noetherian scheme X with derived categories on X and every open U, there are a Type S in universe u and G : S → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X such that every G s is perfect and every perfect P is isomorphic to some G s.

proof.text: Apply Scheme.exists_perfectComplex_representatives to X. IsNoetherian X supplies CompactSpace X and QuasiSeparatedSpace X; the given derived categories on X and its opens supply the remaining hypotheses. Its small indexing type, perfectness, and isomorphism clause are exactly the requested conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Set of perfect representatives, specialized through Scheme.exists_perfectComplex_representatives

lean.statement:
theorem noetherian_perfect_representatives (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [hOpen : ∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    ∃ (S : Type u) (G : S → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X),
      (∀ s : S, Scheme.IsPerfect X (G s).obj) ∧
      ∀ P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, Scheme.IsPerfect X P.obj →
        ∃ s, Nonempty (P ≅ G s)
